response.original_title: All For One: A Run Around the Fells
response.overview: In June 2021, on her fourth attempt, ultra-runner Sabrina Verjee set a new fastest known time for completing a continuous road of the 214 Wainwright fells in the Lake District, finishing her journey of 525km and 36,000m of ascent in five days, 23 hours and 49 minutes. Presented by The Endurance Creative, a collaboration between the film’s director Steve Ashworth and Summit Fever Media, All for One chronicles Sabrina’s personal quest and the contributions of her dedicated support team, and puts on display the Lakeland landscape that she ran through.
